While the reception staff are always polite and helpful, and Dr Ramneek Grewal was thorough and kind, my consultation with Dr S. Morcos left me feeling dismissed and unheard.

As a pregnant patient with a serious infection, I sought clarification on my prescribed antibiotics, as I was initially given the wrong medication and then prescribed another without any testing, dismissing my symptoms once again. I also requested basic tests (CRP, full blood count) to ensure appropriate treatment. Dr. Morcos was condescending, raised his voice, and refused to discuss my concerns, contradicting himself multiple times. Instead of reassuring me, he abruptly ended the call, leaving me distressed and unsupported.

Additionally, the hygiene standards during my blood test were shocking—no handwashing, no gloves, no visible sterile needle preparation, and no skin disinfection before the blood draw. This raises serious infection control concerns.

Patients deserve respectful treatment and proper medical care.
